Priya (Finance): FYI we're gating the bucketed-pricing experiment for a 2-week runway starting Monday. Need sign-off from billing + legal + CFO for go.
Marco (Billing): Can you confirm which SKUs change? I assume embeddings unchanged?
Nora (Product): Correct, only text generation SKUs move to 1k-token buckets. Embeddings/recall unchanged. Sheet: https://redwood-internal/sheets/bucket-pricing-experiment (view).
Tom S.: Rollout plan: 1) opt-in internal alpha 2) 5% random cohort (B) vs 95% control (A) 3) metrics check 24h 4) scale. Flag: `pricing.bucket_experiment`.
Elaine (Legal): Need exact PR wording for invoices and a short TOS blurb. Also confirm we don't touch committed reserved contracts.
Priya (Finance): We'll exempt committed/reserved and named enterprise customers via `billing_exempt` list in the sheet. Nora will maintain the list.
Marco (Billing): Generated a sample invoice preview for cohort B. Link: https://billing-preview.redwood/1789-b. Please validate parsing.
OpsBot: Invoice parser completed dry-run: 47/50 invoices parsed, 3 failed (line-item mapping error). Errors logged: invoice-332, invoice-491, invoice-502.
Marco (Billing): Thanks OpsBot. I'll investigate mapping mismatch for line-item code `gen_text_v2`.
Tom S.: For rollback, feature flag off = immediate revert to old metering. We should also publish customer-facing note if we flip. Nora, draft a 1-paragraph alert for status page.
Nora (Product): Draft done, posting in #announcements after billing + legal sign. Preview: "We're testing a new metering bucket to reduce volatility in small requests. If you're on a reserved plan or an enterprise contract you won't see changes." Thoughts?
Elaine (Legal): Wording OK but add: "No effect on committed usage in reserved plans; contact support for questions."
Priya (Finance): Revenue model check: Marco, what's expected delta for small accounts?
Marco (Billing): Estimate: +0.9% ARR across experiment because rounding favors smaller requests. Range: -0.5% to +2.1% depending on distribution. See attached sample CSV export (we'll upload to the sheet).
Asha (CFO): Approve experimental window contingent on: (1) auto-rollback if negative >1% MRR after 7 days, (2) manual review before scaling.
Priya (Finance): Acknowledged. We'll wire alerts to #finance and send daily digest.
Tom S.: Feature flag payload for QA: ```json
{"flag":"pricing.bucket_experiment","variants":["control","bucketed"],"seed":8675309}```
Marco (Billing): Action items: 1) fix invoice parser errors (Marco) 2) proforma PDFs for top10 customers flagged as potentially impacted (Priya + Marco) 3) legal sign-off on invoice language (Elaine) 4) CFO approval recorded (Asha). I'll attach proformas here when ready.
Priya (Finance): Target to have proformas + parser fix by EOD tomorrow. If any invoice format mismatches persist, we'll pause the cohort.
Nora (Product): Scheduling internal alpha for Friday. Will post updates as threads in #product.
Elaine (Legal): I'll review invoice language and post comments by EOD.
Asha (CFO): Approved under the conditions listed. Keep me looped.
Priya (Finance): Thanks all. If OpsBot surfaces any more parser failures, tag @Marco and @Elaine. :white_check_mark:
